data_a.situation: An adjustment note on job QM-2031-0498 has to reach Ashvale Bridal House before their fitting, and Ashvale accept fitting notes only when addressed to a single named contact.
known_facts: The adjustment is finished: the crown was eased by 6 mm at the left temple and the brim wire was re-set.
The piece is boxed and ready for Ashvale's fitting on Tuesday 14 October at 10:30.
Ashvale return fitting notes sent to their general enquiries address unread.
Ashvale record one named contact per commission on the job card, and the recorded contact differs from commission to commission.
The job card for QM-2031-0498 is in the Bellhouse Yard office and the coordinator has read it.
The fitting cannot go ahead without the adjustment note in the named contact's hands.
constraints: Messages to client staff go out from the workroom manager's account.
The coordinator does not correspond with Ashvale Bridal House directly.
